note: Where fielders stand before the pitch, as distance from the apex of home plate (m) and direction (degrees, 0 = centre field, + = first-base side). Basis A: close to MLB average starting positions (docs/13 S5-2). Variants move players from the normal spots.

pull_shift_deg.note: Infielders lean toward the batter's pull side by this many degrees (left-handed batter: + toward first)

outfield_margin_m.note: Outfielders stand at least this far inside the fence
